name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 6 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 14 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
